name: zrndr_overlay_blend_row565_scalar
description: zRndr::OverlayBlendRow565_Scalar blends packed RGB565 software overlay rows two pixels at a time.
known_limits: Current VC5SP3 byte comparison `python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 zrndr_overlay_blend_rows` fails for 0x48d4b0 with 67 unmasked function-byte mismatches, 12 relocation-masked bytes, 12 trimmed VC NOP bytes, Binary Ninja body size 82, and VC symbol size 96.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48d4b0 validates per-pixel RGB565 channel masking, destination scaling, overlay source scaling, and recomposition.
The native smoke verifies FlushSw's RGB565 scalar path blends only the requested rectangle pixels.
